text:
ana: noticed post-deploy smoke for /kv-prefill showing elevated 503s on canary (5%). holding ramp.

deploy-bot: deploy bot: rollout v2.9.0 -> v2.9.1 at 1757772400, canary 5%. smoke probes started 1757772430. recent probe failures: 14/70.

dave: looks correlated with prefill worker change that increases parallel fetches (prefill-parallelism 8->16). could be upstream backend saturation.

ops-bot: config snapshot: prefill-parallelism=16 shipped in release config. no kernel/quant changes.

ana: let's reduce prefill-parallelism to 8 for canary only and re-run focused prefill synth. that should reduce backend pressure without rolling back code.

sre: agree. also add a temporary backend retry jitter to avoid thundering herd while we observe.

dave: applying canary override now via config service: POST /internal/configs/overrides {"scope":"canary","prefill_parallelism":8,"backend_retry_jitter":true} (ops token used). change applied at 1757772508.

deploy-bot: synth runners restarted 1757772520 -> collecting 40 samples/min targeted at /kv-prefill.

qa: focused synth results after 3m: failures down to 3/120 (2.5%) from 20/120 previously. p95 latency trending down.

ana: good. keep hold for 10m observation. if stable (<1% failures and p95 within 15% of baseline) proceed to 25% ramp. else we pin canary to v2.9.0 and schedule rollback.

sre: logging note: created incident stub INC-2026-kv-prefill for postmortem if we roll back.

dave: will open a PR to revert prefill-parallelism increase in the next patch release; short-term config override seems to mitigate.

ops-bot: reminder: to pin traffic back to v2.9.0 use routing API: POST /api/routing/pin {"route":"/kv-prefill","version":"v2.9.0","scope":"canary"} (requires ops auth).

ana: thanks team. im leaving the hold in place. will update release notes: "temporary prefill config adjusted on canary to reduce backend saturation; follow-up patch inbound."
